topic.title: Hangman Step 2
topic.description: Adds a display list of underscores and reveals correctly guessed letters in their positions. Builds on step 1 with list manipulation.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Using enumerate() to loop with both index and value, updating a display list at specific positions.
learningNotes.challenges: Correctly matching letter positions in the word to display list indices.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Step 3: add a while loop for repeated guessing.
